description: Experienced in production scheduling, Lean manufacturing and design.
Analytical, capable of procurement specialist for cost reduction and containment.
Expertise in 5S methodology, QA/QC/Audits reports, value stream mapping, multi-site operations.
Dedicated to product quality and process improvement strategies.
Developed, updated, and maintained SOPs, Client Guidelines, HR and Technical Manuals and Protocols for Insight Company.

Accountable for implementation of strategic objectives, developing operations strategy, planning production services, and client communication.
Actively suggested operational improvements to enhance quality, improve production times, and reduce costs.

matchmaking_summary: Results-driven, skilled Quality Specialist focused on achieving success and increased productivity through improvements in quality, safety, operations, and administration. Expertise in quality control, quality assurance, lean management, Six Sigma, and techniques and methods for improving the efficiency process of an organization's quality procedure. Highly motivated with the aptitude and tenacity to resolve challenging issues and work productively with team members and supervisors to accomplish the organization's future vision and goal.
